title: Seventh Constable's History
full_text:
The Seventh Constable spoke:

'An unscrupulous nephew produced a handwritten will, claiming that his late wealthy uncle had disinherited all his daughters and bequeathed his entire estate to him twenty years ago. The parchment looked ancient and yellow.

I held the parchment against the strong sunlight and examined the watermark embedded in the fibers of the paper: it bore the crescent mark of a paper-mill in Damascus that was constructed only three years ago!

The forgery was exposed instantly; the nephew confessed his crime, the daughters received their rightful inheritance, and the city marveled at the science of the watermark.'
moral: Scientific inquiry and testing materials dismantle the most cunning legal forgeries.
